tap-module-pointer-validity.obligation: Before `vsock_add_tap`, Rust must populate the vsock tap `dev` and `module` pointers with values that outlive the registration.
tap-module-pointer-validity.preferred_discharge: Thread `&'static ThisModule` through a dedicated `vsock_tap` abstraction and write module/device pointers inside the wrapper.

tap-open-stop-balance.obligation: Open/stop shims must keep vsock tap registration balanced and avoid double-remove on partially initialized state.
tap-open-stop-balance.preferred_discharge: Model tap state explicitly in the wrapper or rely on netdevice lifecycle invariants while keeping transitions localized.
